title: World Medical Association Declaration of Helsinki
summary_zh: 本文介绍世界医学协会赫尔辛基宣言的2024年修订版，指导医学研究中参与者的伦理待遇。
summary_en: This paper presents the 2024 revision of the World Medical Association's Declaration of Helsinki, guiding ethical treatment of participants in medical research.
insights: 创新点：赫尔辛基宣言2024年修订版
方法亮点：指导医学研究伦理
关键发现：伦理原则更新
insights_en: Novelty: 2024 revision of the Declaration of Helsinki
Method highlight: Guides ethical treatment in medical research
Key finding: Updated ethical principles
abstract: This JAMA Special Communication presents the 2024 revision of the World Medical Association’s Declaration of Helsinki, a set of principles to guide the ethical treatment of participants in medical research.

title: The 2024 report of the Lancet Countdown on health and climate change: facing record-breaking threats from delayed action
Neuronal wiring diagram of an adult brain
summary_zh: 通过电子显微镜图像绘制神经元连接图。重建全脑连接图，包含大量化学突触。数据产品可供下载。
summary_en: Neuronal wiring diagram of an adult brain mapped through electron microscopic brain images. Reconstruct whole-brain connectivity map with a large number of chemical synapses. Data products are available for download.
insights: 神经元连接图绘制
全脑连接图重建
数据产品可用
insights_en: Drawing of neuronal wiring diagram
Reconstruction of whole-brain connectivity map
Availability of data products
abstract: Connections between neurons can be mapped by acquiring and analysing electron microscopic brain images. In recent years, this approach has been applied to chunks of brains to reconstruct local connectivity maps that are highly informative<sup>1-6</sup>, but nevertheless inadequate for understanding brain function more globally. Here we present a neuronal wiring diagram of a whole brain containing 5 × 10<sup>7</sup> chemical synapses<sup>7</sup> between 139,255 neurons reconstructed from an adult female Drosophila melanogaster<sup>8,9</sup>. The resource also incorporates annotations of cell classes and types, nerves, hemilineages and predictions of neurotransmitter identities<sup>10-12</sup>. Data products are available for download, programmatic access and interactive browsing and have been made interoperable with other fly data resources. We derive a projectome-a map of projections between regions-from the connectome and report on tracing of synaptic pathways and the analysis of information flow from inputs (sensory and ascending neurons) to outputs (motor, endocrine and descending neurons) across both hemispheres and between the central brain and the optic lobes. Tracing from a subset of photoreceptors to descending motor pathways illustrates how structure can uncover putative circuit mechanisms underlying sensorimotor behaviours. The technologies and open ecosystem reported here set the stage for future large-scale connectome projects in other species.

title: Testing and Evaluation of Health Care Applications of Large Language Models
summary_zh: 本文提出对大型语言模型在医疗保健中的应用进行测试和评估，关注公平性、偏见和毒性。
summary_en: This paper proposes testing and evaluating the application of large language models in healthcare, focusing on fairness, bias, and toxicity.
insights: 创新点：提出对LLM在医疗保健中的应用进行评估
方法亮点：关注公平性、偏见和毒性
关键发现：LLM应用需考虑多方面因素
insights_en: Novelty: Proposes evaluation of LLM applications in healthcare
Method highlight: Focuses on fairness, bias, and toxicity
Key finding: LLM applications require consideration of multiple factors
abstract: Existing evaluations of LLMs mostly focus on accuracy of question answering for medical examinations, without consideration of real patient care data. Dimensions such as fairness, bias, and toxicity and deployment considerations received limited attention. Future evaluations should adopt standardized applications and metrics, use clinical data, and broaden focus to include a wider range of tasks and specialties.

title: FDA Perspective on the Regulation of Artificial Intelligence in Health Care and Biomedicine
summary_zh: FDA强调对医疗保健和生物医学中人工智能的严格监管，以确保技术的安全、有效和可信。
summary_en: The FDA emphasizes strict regulation of artificial intelligence in healthcare and biomedicine to ensure the safety, effectiveness, and trustworthiness of the technology.
insights: 创新点：FDA强调人工智能的严格监管。
方法亮点：确保技术的安全、有效和可信。
关键发现：FDA在人工智能监管中的核心作用。
insights_en: Novelty: The FDA emphasizes strict regulation of AI.
Method highlight: Ensuring the safety, effectiveness, and trustworthiness of the technology.
Key finding: The central role of the FDA in AI regulation.
abstract: Strong oversight by the FDA protects the long-term success of industries by focusing on evaluation to advance regulated technologies that improve health. The FDA will continue to play a central role in ensuring safe, effective, and trustworthy AI tools to improve the lives of patients and clinicians alike. However, all involved entities will need to attend to AI with the rigor this transformative technology merits.

title: Empowering biomedical discovery with AI agents
summary_zh: 研究AI科学家系统在生物医学发现中的应用，通过协作代理整合AI模型和生物医学工具。
summary_en: This study investigates the application of AI scientist systems in biomedical discovery, integrating AI models and biomedical tools through collaborative agents.
insights: 创新点：AI科学家系统在生物医学中的应用
方法亮点：AI与生物医学工具的整合
关键发现：AI在发现过程中的作用
insights_en: Novelty: Application of AI scientist systems in biomedical discovery
Method highlight: Integration of AI with biomedical tools
Key finding: Role of AI in the discovery process
abstract: We envision "AI scientists" as systems capable of skeptical learning and reasoning that empower biomedical research through collaborative agents that integrate AI models and biomedical tools with experimental platforms. Rather than taking humans out of the discovery process, biomedical AI agents combine human creativity and expertise with AI's ability to analyze large datasets, navigate hypothesis spaces, and execute repetitive tasks. AI agents are poised to be proficient in various tasks, planning discovery workflows and performing self-assessment to identify and mitigate gaps in their knowledge. These agents use large language models and generative models to feature structured memory for continual learning and use machine learning tools to incorporate scientific knowledge, biological principles, and theories. AI agents can impact areas ranging from virtual cell simulation, programmable control of phenotypes, and the design of cellular circuits to developing new therapies.

title: A core microbiome signature as an indicator of health
summary_zh: 通过分析宏基因组数据，确定了与健康相关的核心肠道微生物组，并建立了区分病例和对照的模型。
summary_en: A core gut microbiome signature associated with health is identified through metagenomic analysis, and a model distinguishing cases from controls is established.
insights: 创新点：发现与健康相关的核心肠道微生物组
方法亮点：系统生物学方法分析宏基因组数据
关键发现：区分病例和对照的模型
insights_en: Novelty: Identification of a core gut microbiome associated with health
Method highlight: Systems biology approach for metagenomic data analysis
Key finding: Model distinguishing cases from controls
abstract: The gut microbiota is crucial for human health, functioning as a complex adaptive system akin to a vital organ. To identify core health-relevant gut microbes, we followed the systems biology tenet that stable relationships signify core components. By analyzing metagenomic datasets from a high-fiber dietary intervention in type 2 diabetes and 26 case-control studies across 15 diseases, we identified a set of stably correlated genome pairs within co-abundance networks perturbed by dietary interventions and diseases. These genomes formed a "two competing guilds" (TCGs) model, with one guild specialized in fiber fermentation and butyrate production and the other characterized by virulence and antibiotic resistance. Our random forest models successfully distinguished cases from controls across multiple diseases and predicted immunotherapy outcomes through the use of these genomes. Our guild-based approach, which is genome specific, database independent, and interaction focused, identifies a core microbiome signature that serves as a holistic health indicator and a potential common target for health enhancement.

title: Evaluating large language models in theory of mind tasks
summary_zh: 评估11个大型语言模型在理论思维任务中的表现。发现ChatGPT-4在理论思维任务中表现与6岁儿童相当。
summary_en: This study evaluates the performance of 11 large language models in theory of mind tasks. It finds that ChatGPT-4 performs similarly to 6-year-old children in theory of mind tasks.
insights: 创新点：评估大型语言模型在理论思维任务中的能力
方法亮点：使用40个定制错误信念任务
关键发现：ChatGPT-4在理论思维任务中表现优异
insights_en: Novelty: Evaluating the ability of large language models in theory of mind tasks
Method highlight: Using 40 bespoke false-belief tasks
Key finding: ChatGPT-4 performs exceptionally in theory of mind tasks
abstract: Eleven large language models (LLMs) were assessed using 40 bespoke false-belief tasks, considered a gold standard in testing theory of mind (ToM) in humans. Each task included a false-belief scenario, three closely matched true-belief control scenarios, and the reversed versions of all four. An LLM had to solve all eight scenarios to solve a single task. Older models solved no tasks; Generative Pre-trained Transformer (GPT)-3-davinci-003 (from November 2022) and ChatGPT-3.5-turbo (from March 2023) solved 20% of the tasks; ChatGPT-4 (from June 2023) solved 75% of the tasks, matching the performance of 6-y-old children observed in past studies. We explore the potential interpretation of these results, including the intriguing possibility that ToM-like ability, previously considered unique to humans, may have emerged as an unintended by-product of LLMs' improving language skills. Regardless of how we interpret these outcomes, they signify the advent of more powerful and socially skilled AI-with profound positive and negative implications.

title: Global rise in forest fire emissions linked to climate change in the extratropics
summary_zh: 本研究使用机器学习将森林生态区系统地分为12个全球森林火灾区域，每个区域对气候、人类和植被控制的敏感性各不相同。
summary_en: This study used machine learning to systematically group forest ecoregions into 12 global forest pyromes, each showing distinct sensitivities to climatic, human, and vegetation controls.
insights: 创新点：使用机器学习对森林火灾区域进行分类
方法亮点：分析气候、人类和植被控制因素
关键发现：全球森林火灾排放量与气候变化的联系
insights_en: Novelty: Classification of forest fire regions using machine learning
Method highlight: Analysis of climatic, human, and vegetation control factors
Key finding: Link between global forest fire emissions and climate change
abstract: Climate change increases fire-favorable weather in forests, but fire trends are also affected by multiple other controlling factors that are difficult to untangle. We use machine learning to systematically group forest ecoregions into 12 global forest pyromes, with each showing distinct sensitivities to climatic, human, and vegetation controls. This delineation revealed that rapidly increasing forest fire emissions in extratropical pyromes, linked to climate change, offset declining emissions in tropical pyromes during 2001 to 2023. Annual emissions tripled in one extratropical pyrome due to increases in fire-favorable weather, compounded by increased forest cover and productivity. This contributed to a 60% increase in forest fire carbon emissions from forest ecoregions globally. Our results highlight the increasing vulnerability of forests and their carbon stocks to fire disturbance under climate change.

title: Building pangenome graphs
Long-term stability in perovskite solar cells through atomic layer deposition of tin oxide
summary_zh: 通过原子层沉积SnO x 提高钙钛矿太阳能电池稳定性。SnO x 层提供耐用电子传输层，提升电池效率。
summary_en: Enhances long-term stability of perovskite solar cells through atomic layer deposition of SnO x. SnO x layer provides durable electron transport layer, improving cell efficiency.
insights: 原子层沉积提高稳定性
SnO x 层作为耐用电子传输层
提升电池效率
insights_en: Atomic layer deposition enhances stability
SnO x layer as durable electron transport layer
Improves cell efficiency
abstract: Robust contact schemes that boost stability and simplify the production process are needed for perovskite solar cells (PSCs). We codeposited perovskite and hole-selective contact while protecting the perovskite to enable deposition of SnO x /Ag without the use of a fullerene. The SnO x , prepared through atomic layer deposition, serves as a durable inorganic electron transport layer. Tailoring the oxygen vacancy defects in the SnO x layer led to power conversion efficiencies (PCEs) of >25%. Our devices exhibit superior stability over conventional p-i-n PSCs, successfully meeting several benchmark stability tests. They retained >95% PCE after 2000 hours of continuous operation at their maximum power point under simulated AM1.5 illumination at 65°C. Additionally, they boast a certified T 97 lifetime exceeding 1000 hours.

title: Restrictive vs Liberal Transfusion Strategy in Patients With Acute Brain Injury
summary_zh: 比较限制性 vs. 限制性输血策略在急性脑损伤患者中的应用。
summary_en: Comparing restrictive vs. liberal transfusion strategies in patients with acute brain injury.
insights: 创新点：比较输血策略
方法亮点：急性脑损伤患者研究
关键发现：输血策略比较
insights_en: Novelty: Comparing transfusion strategies
Method highlight: Acute brain injury patient study
Key finding: Transfusion strategy comparison
abstract: ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT02968654.

title: CTLA4 blockade abrogates KEAP1/STK11-related resistance to PD-(L)1 inhibitors
summary_zh: 研究发现，STK11和/或KEAP1突变患者从CTLA4和PD-1/L1抑制剂联合治疗中获益。实验表明，联合治疗显著提高抗肿瘤活性和免疫相关毒性。
summary_en: Findings show that patients with STK11 and/or KEAP1 mutations benefit from combined CTLA4 and PD-1/L1 inhibitor therapy. Experiments indicate that combined therapy significantly improves anti-tumor activity and immune-related toxicities.
insights: 创新点：发现STK11和/或KEAP1突变患者从联合治疗中获益
方法亮点：联合治疗显著提高抗肿瘤活性和免疫相关毒性
关键发现：联合治疗优于单药治疗
insights_en: Novelty: Identified that patients with STK11 and/or KEAP1 mutations benefit from combined therapy
Method highlight: Combined therapy significantly improves anti-tumor activity and immune-related toxicities
Key finding: Combined therapy is superior to monotherapy
abstract: For patients with advanced non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC), dual immune checkpoint blockade (ICB) with CTLA4 inhibitors and PD-1 or PD-L1 inhibitors (hereafter, PD-(L)1 inhibitors) is associated with higher rates of anti-tumour activity and immune-related toxicities, when compared with treatment with PD-(L)1 inhibitors alone. However, there are currently no validated biomarkers to identify which patients will benefit from dual ICB<sup>1,2</sup>. Here we show that patients with NSCLC who have mutations in the STK11 and/or KEAP1 tumour suppressor genes derived clinical benefit from dual ICB with the PD-L1 inhibitor durvalumab and the CTLA4 inhibitor tremelimumab, but not from durvalumab alone, when added to chemotherapy in the randomized phase III POSEIDON trial<sup>3</sup>. Unbiased genetic screens identified loss of both of these tumour suppressor genes as independent drivers of resistance to PD-(L)1 inhibition, and showed that loss of Keap1 was the strongest genomic predictor of dual ICB efficacy-a finding that was confirmed in several mouse models of Kras-driven NSCLC. In both mouse models and patients, KEAP1 and STK11 alterations were associated with an adverse tumour microenvironment, which was characterized by a preponderance of suppressive myeloid cells and the depletion of CD8<sup>+</sup> cytotoxic T cells, but relative sparing of CD4<sup>+</sup> effector subsets. Dual ICB potently engaged CD4<sup>+</sup> effector cells and reprogrammed the tumour myeloid cell compartment towards inducible nitric oxide synthase (iNOS)-expressing tumoricidal phenotypes that-together with CD4<sup>+</sup> and CD8<sup>+</sup> T cells-contributed to anti-tumour efficacy. These data support the use of chemo-immunotherapy with dual ICB to mitigate resistance to PD-(L)1 inhibition in patients with NSCLC who have STK11 and/or KEAP1 alterations.

title: AAV gene therapy for Duchenne muscular dystrophy: the EMBARK phase 3 randomized trial
summary_zh: DMD基因疗法治疗杜氏肌营养不良。EMBARK III期临床试验评估疗效和安全。结果显示积极。
summary_en: AAV gene therapy for Duchenne muscular dystrophy. The EMBARK phase 3 randomized trial assesses efficacy and safety. Results are positive.
insights: 创新点：基因疗法治疗DMD
方法亮点：随机对照试验设计
关键发现：基因疗法安全有效
insights_en: Novelty: Gene therapy for DMD
Method highlight: Randomized controlled trial design
Key finding: Gene therapy is safe and effective
abstract: Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD) is a rare, X-linked neuromuscular disease caused by pathogenic variants in the DMD gene that result in the absence of functional dystrophin, beginning at birth and leading to progressive impaired motor function, loss of ambulation and life-threatening cardiorespiratory complications. Delandistrogene moxeparvovec, an adeno-associated rh74-viral vector-based gene therapy, addresses absent functional dystrophin in DMD. Here the phase 3 EMBARK study aimed to assess the efficacy and safety of delandistrogene moxeparvovec in patients with DMD. Ambulatory males with DMD, ≥4 years to <8 years of age, were randomized and stratified by age group and North Star Ambulatory Assessment (NSAA) score to single-administration intravenous delandistrogene moxeparvovec (1.33 × 10<sup>14</sup> vector genomes per kilogram; n = 63) or placebo (n = 62). At week 52, the primary endpoint, change from baseline in NSAA score, was not met (least squares mean 2.57 (delandistrogene moxeparvovec) versus 1.92 (placebo) points; between-group difference, 0.65; 95% confidence interval (CI), -0.45, 1.74; P = 0.2441). Secondary efficacy endpoints included mean micro-dystrophin expression at week 12: 34.29% (treated) versus 0.00% (placebo). Other secondary efficacy endpoints at week 52 (between-group differences (95% CI)) included: Time to Rise (-0.64 (-1.06, -0.23)), 10-meter Walk/Run (-0.42 (-0.71, -0.13)), stride velocity 95th centile (0.10 (0.00, 0.19)), 100-meter Walk/Run (-3.29 (-8.28, 1.70)), time to ascend 4 steps (-0.36 (-0.71, -0.01)), PROMIS Mobility and Upper Extremity (0.05 (-0.08, 0.19); -0.04 (-0.24, 0.17)) and number of NSAA skills gained/improved (0.19 (-0.67, 1.06)). In total, 674 adverse events were recorded with delandistrogene moxeparvovec and 514 with placebo. There were no deaths, discontinuations or clinically significant complement-mediated adverse events; 7 patients (11.1%) experienced 10 treatment-related serious adverse events. Delandistrogene moxeparvovec did not lead to a significant improvement in NSAA score at week 52. Some of the secondary endpoints numerically favored treatment, although no statistical significance can be claimed. Safety was manageable and consistent with previous delandistrogene moxeparvovec trials. ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT05096221.

title: AAV gene therapy for Duchenne muscular dystrophy: the EMBARK phase 3 randomized trial
summary_zh: EMBARK III期临床试验评估delandistrogene moxeparvovec基因治疗Duchenne肌营养不良症的有效性和安全性。
summary_en: The EMBARK phase 3 randomized trial assesses the efficacy and safety of delandistrogene moxeparvovec gene therapy for Duchenne muscular dystrophy.

方法亮点：EMBARK临床试验
关键发现：有效性和安全性
insights_en: Novelty: Gene therapy for Duchenne muscular dystrophy
Method highlight: EMBARK clinical trial
Key finding: Efficacy and safety

title: Probiotic neoantigen delivery vectors for precision cancer immunotherapy
summary_zh: 研究开发益生菌作为递送载体，增强癌症免疫治疗中肿瘤新抗原的递送。
summary_en: This study develops probiotics as delivery vectors to enhance the delivery of tumor neoantigens in cancer immunotherapy.
insights: 创新点：益生菌作为递送载体
方法亮点：增强肿瘤新抗原递送
关键发现：提高癌症免疫治疗效果
insights_en: Novelty: Probiotics as delivery vectors
Method highlight: Enhanced delivery of tumor neoantigens
Key finding: Improved efficacy of cancer immunotherapy
abstract: Microbial systems have been synthetically engineered to deploy therapeutic payloads in vivo<sup>1,2</sup>. With emerging evidence that bacteria naturally home in on tumours<sup>3,4</sup> and modulate antitumour immunity<sup>5,6</sup>, one promising application is the development of bacterial vectors as precision cancer vaccines<sup>2,7</sup>. Here we engineered probiotic Escherichia coli Nissle 1917 as an antitumour vaccination platform optimized for enhanced production and cytosolic delivery of neoepitope-containing peptide arrays, with increased susceptibility to blood clearance and phagocytosis. These features enhance both safety and immunogenicity, achieving a system that drives potent and specific T cell-mediated anticancer immunity that effectively controls or eliminates tumour growth and extends survival in advanced murine primary and metastatic solid tumours. We demonstrate that the elicited antitumour immune response involves recruitment and activation of dendritic cells, extensive priming and activation of neoantigen-specific CD4<sup>+</sup> and CD8<sup>+</sup> T cells, broader activation of both T and natural killer cells, and a reduction of tumour-infiltrating immunosuppressive myeloid and regulatory T and B cell populations. Taken together, this work leverages the advantages of living medicines to deliver arrays of tumour-specific neoantigen-derived epitopes within the optimal context to induce specific, effective and durable systemic antitumour immunity.

title: The development and impact of tin selenide on thermoelectrics
summary_zh: 研究锡硒化物在热电中的应用和发展。锡硒化物具有高热电效率，对其他材料系统有重要启示。
summary_en: Studies the development and impact of tin selenide on thermoelectrics. Tin selenide has high thermoelectric efficiency, providing important insights for other material systems.
insights: 创新点：发现锡硒化物的高热电效率
方法亮点：研究锡硒化物的热电性能
关键发现：锡硒化物对其他材料系统的影响
insights_en: Novelty: Discovery of high thermoelectric efficiency of tin selenide
Method highlight: Study of the thermoelectric properties of tin selenide
Key finding: Impact of tin selenide on other material systems
abstract: Thermoelectric technology experienced rapid development over the past 20 years, with the most promising applications being in both power generation and active cooling. Among existing thermoelectrics, tin selenide (SnSe) has had particularly rapid development owing to the unexpectedly high thermoelectric efficiency that has been continuously established over the past decade. Several transport mechanisms and strategies used to interpret and improve the thermoelectric performance of SnSe have been important for understanding and developing other material systems with SnSe-like characteristics. Similar to other thermoelectrics, building commercially viable SnSe-based devices requires advances in device efficiency and service stability. Further optimization across all material systems should enable thermoelectric technology to play a critical role in the future global energy landscape.

title: Induction chemotherapy followed by standard chemoradiotherapy versus standard chemoradiotherapy alone in patients with locally advanced cervical cancer (GCIG INTERLACE): an international, multicentre, randomised phase 3 trial
summary_zh: 比较诱导化疗后标准放化疗与单独放化疗在局部晚期宫颈癌患者中的疗效。
summary_en: Comparing induction chemotherapy followed by standard chemoradiotherapy with standard chemoradiotherapy alone in patients with locally advanced cervical cancer.
insights: 创新点：比较两种治疗方案疗效
方法亮点：国际多中心随机三期临床试验
关键发现：疗效比较结果

Method highlight: International multicentre randomised phase 3 trial
Key finding: Efficacy comparison results
abstract: Cancer Research UK and University College London-University College London Hospitals Biomedical Research Centre.

title: Progressive plasticity during colorectal cancer metastasis
summary_zh: 揭示结直肠癌转移过程中细胞状态变化和转移机制。
summary_en: Discovers cell state changes and metastatic mechanisms during colorectal cancer metastasis.
insights: 创新点：结直肠癌转移过程中的细胞状态变化
方法亮点：揭示转移机制
关键发现：转移细胞状态与治疗
insights_en: Novelty: Cell state changes during colorectal cancer metastasis
Method highlight: Revealing the metastatic mechanisms
Key finding: Metastatic cell states and therapy
abstract: As cancers progress, they become increasingly aggressive-metastatic tumours are less responsive to first-line therapies than primary tumours, they acquire resistance to successive therapies and eventually cause death<sup>1,2</sup>. Mutations are largely conserved between primary and metastatic tumours from the same patients, suggesting that non-genetic phenotypic plasticity has a major role in cancer progression and therapy resistance<sup>3-5</sup>. However, we lack an understanding of metastatic cell states and the mechanisms by which they transition. Here, in a cohort of biospecimen trios from same-patient normal colon, primary and metastatic colorectal cancer, we show that, although primary tumours largely adopt LGR5<sup>+</sup> intestinal stem-like states, metastases display progressive plasticity. Cancer cells lose intestinal cell identities and reprogram into a highly conserved fetal progenitor state before undergoing non-canonical differentiation into divergent squamous and neuroendocrine-like states, a process that is exacerbated in metastasis and by chemotherapy and is associated with poor patient survival. Using matched patient-derived organoids, we demonstrate that metastatic cells exhibit greater cell-autonomous multilineage differentiation potential in response to microenvironment cues compared with their intestinal lineage-restricted primary tumour counterparts. We identify PROX1 as a repressor of non-intestinal lineage in the fetal progenitor state, and show that downregulation of PROX1 licenses non-canonical reprogramming.

title: Tumour evolution and microenvironment interactions in 2D and 3D space
authors: André Luiz N. Targino da Costa
summary_zh: 通过Visium空间转录组学等技术研究肿瘤微环境。定义肿瘤微区域，发现不同癌症类型中微区域大小和密度差异。
summary_en: Studies tumor microenvironment using techniques like Visium spatial transcriptomics. Defines tumor microregions and finds size and density variations among cancer types.
insights: 创新点：应用Visium空间转录组学等技术研究肿瘤微环境
方法亮点：定义肿瘤微区域
关键发现：发现微区域大小和密度差异
insights_en: Novelty: Applies techniques like Visium spatial transcriptomics to study tumor microenvironment
Method highlight: Defines tumor microregions
Key finding: Finds size and density variations among microregions
abstract: To study the spatial interactions among cancer and non-cancer cells<sup>1</sup>, we here examined a cohort of 131 tumour sections from 78 cases across 6 cancer types by Visium spatial transcriptomics (ST). This was combined with 48 matched single-nucleus RNA sequencing samples and 22 matched co-detection by indexing (CODEX) samples. To describe tumour structures and habitats, we defined 'tumour microregions' as spatially distinct cancer cell clusters separated by stromal components. They varied in size and density among cancer types, with the largest microregions observed in metastatic samples. We further grouped microregions with shared genetic alterations into 'spatial subclones'. Thirty five tumour sections exhibited subclonal structures. Spatial subclones with distinct copy number variations and mutations displayed differential oncogenic activities. We identified increased metabolic activity at the centre and increased antigen presentation along the leading edges of microregions. We also observed variable T cell infiltrations within microregions and macrophages predominantly residing at tumour boundaries. We reconstructed 3D tumour structures by co-registering 48 serial ST sections from 16 samples, which provided insights into the spatial organization and heterogeneity of tumours. Additionally, using an unsupervised deep-learning algorithm and integrating ST and CODEX data, we identified both immune hot and cold neighbourhoods and enhanced immune exhaustion markers surrounding the 3D subclones. These findings contribute to the understanding of spatial tumour evolution through interactions with the local microenvironment in 2D and 3D space, providing valuable insights into tumour biology.

title: AI can help humans find common ground in democratic deliberation
summary_zh: 研究AI在民主协商中帮助人们找到共同点。方法上，通过AI生成表达群体共识的陈述。结果显示，AI生成的陈述更受欢迎。
summary_en: Studies how AI can help humans find common ground in democratic deliberation. Methods involve using AI to generate statements expressing group consensus. Results show that AI-generated statements are more popular.
insights: 创新点：AI在民主协商中的应用
方法亮点：AI生成群体共识陈述
关键发现：AI生成陈述更受欢迎
insights_en: Novelty: Application of AI in democratic deliberation
Method highlight: AI generates group consensus statements
Key finding: AI-generated statements are more popular
abstract: Finding agreement through a free exchange of views is often difficult. Collective deliberation can be slow, difficult to scale, and unequally attentive to different voices. In this study, we trained an artificial intelligence (AI) to mediate human deliberation. Using participants' personal opinions and critiques, the AI mediator iteratively generates and refines statements that express common ground among the group on social or political issues. Participants (N = 5734) preferred AI-generated statements to those written by human mediators, rating them as more informative, clear, and unbiased. Discussants often updated their views after the deliberation, converging on a shared perspective. Text embeddings revealed that successful group statements incorporated dissenting voices while respecting the majority position. These findings were replicated in a virtual citizens' assembly involving a demographically representative sample of the UK population.

title: Mpox Clinical Presentation, Diagnostic Approaches, and Treatment Strategies
summary_zh: 探讨猴痘的临床表现、诊断方法和治疗策略。
summary_en: This paper discusses the clinical presentation, diagnostic approaches, and treatment strategies for mpox.
insights: 创新点：强调猴痘疫苗接种的重要性。
方法亮点：提供详细的诊断流程。
关键发现：支持性治疗为一线疗法。
insights_en: Novelty: Emphasizes the importance of mpox vaccination.
Method highlight: Provides a detailed diagnostic process.
Key finding: Supportive care is the first-line therapy.
abstract: Mpox is a viral infection transmitted primarily through close skin to skin contact that typically causes a self-resolving illness but can result in severe illness and death in immunocompromised individuals. First-line therapy is supportive care, although patients with severe mpox infection may be treated with advanced therapeutics. Mpox vaccination is effective and, if available, should be offered to individuals at risk of exposure to mpox.

title: A scoping review of reporting gaps in FDA-approved AI medical devices
summary_zh: 审查FDA批准的AI医疗设备报告，发现透明度、安全报告和社会人口统计数据不足。
summary_en: Scoping review of reporting gaps in FDA-approved AI medical devices finds insufficient transparency, safety reporting, and sociodemographic data.
insights: 创新点：审查报告差距
方法亮点：透明度评估
关键发现：数据不足
insights_en: Novelty: Reviewing reporting gaps
Method highlight: Transparency assessment
Key finding: Insufficient data
abstract: Machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI/ML) models in healthcare may exacerbate health biases. Regulatory oversight is critical in evaluating the safety and effectiveness of AI/ML devices in clinical settings. We conducted a scoping review on the 692 FDA-approved AI/ML-enabled medical devices approved from 1995-2023 to examine transparency, safety reporting, and sociodemographic representation. Only 3.6% of approvals reported race/ethnicity, 99.1% provided no socioeconomic data. 81.6% did not report the age of study subjects. Only 46.1% provided comprehensive detailed results of performance studies; only 1.9% included a link to a scientific publication with safety and efficacy data. Only 9.0% contained a prospective study for post-market surveillance. Despite the growing number of market-approved medical devices, our data shows that FDA reporting data remains inconsistent. Demographic and socioeconomic characteristics are underreported, exacerbating the risk of algorithmic bias and health disparity.

title: LSKNet: A Foundation Lightweight Backbone for Remote Sensing
Spatial proteomics identifies JAKi as treatment for a lethal skin disease
summary_zh: 研究通过空间蛋白质组学识别JAKi作为致命性皮肤病的治疗方法。方法为分析皮肤组织活检以识别潜在药物靶点。结果显示JAKi可能成为TEN的有效治疗。
summary_en: This study identifies JAKi as a potential treatment for a lethal skin disease through spatial proteomics. The method involves analyzing archived skin tissue biopsies to identify potential drug targets. The results suggest that JAKi may be an effective treatment for TEN.
insights: 创新点：应用空间蛋白质组学识别药物靶点
方法亮点：分析皮肤组织以系统映射分子变化
关键发现：JAKi可能成为TEN的有效治疗
insights_en: Novelty: Application of spatial proteomics to identify drug targets
Method highlight: Analysis of skin tissue to systematically map molecular changes
Key finding: JAKi may be an effective treatment for TEN
abstract: Toxic epidermal necrolysis (TEN) is a fatal drug-induced skin reaction triggered by common medications and is an emerging public health issue<sup>1-3</sup>. Patients with TEN undergo severe and sudden epidermal detachment caused by keratinocyte cell death. Although molecular mechanisms that drive keratinocyte cell death have been proposed, the main drivers remain unknown, and there is no effective therapy for TEN<sup>4-6</sup>. Here, to systematically map molecular changes that are associated with TEN and identify potential druggable targets, we utilized deep visual proteomics, which provides single-cell-based, cell-type-resolution proteomics<sup>7,8</sup>. We analysed formalin-fixed, paraffin-embedded archived skin tissue biopsies of three types of cutaneous drug reactions with varying severity and quantified more than 5,000 proteins in keratinocytes and skin-infiltrating immune cells. This revealed a marked enrichment of type I and type II interferon signatures in the immune cell and keratinocyte compartment of patients with TEN, as well as phosphorylated STAT1 activation. Targeted inhibition with the pan-JAK inhibitor tofacitinib in vitro reduced keratinocyte-directed cytotoxicity. In vivo oral administration of tofacitinib, baricitinib or the JAK1-specific inhibitors abrocitinib or upadacitinib ameliorated clinical and histological disease severity in two distinct mouse models of TEN. Crucially, treatment with JAK inhibitors (JAKi) was safe and associated with rapid cutaneous re-epithelialization and recovery in seven patients with TEN. This study uncovers the JAK/STAT and interferon signalling pathways as key pathogenic drivers of TEN and demonstrates the potential of targeted JAKi as a curative therapy.

title: Soft hydrogel semiconductors with augmented biointeractive functions
summary_zh: 开发了一种溶剂亲和性组装方法，将水不溶性聚合物半导体引入双网络水凝胶中。
summary_en: Develops a solvent affinity-induced assembly method to incorporate water-insoluble polymer semiconductors into double-network hydrogels.
insights: 创新点：引入半导体增强生物相互作用
方法亮点：溶剂亲和性组装方法
关键发现：新型软水凝胶半导体
insights_en: Novelty: Introduce semiconductors to enhance biointeractions
Method highlight: Solvent affinity-induced assembly
Key finding: Novel soft hydrogel semiconductors
abstract: Hydrogels, known for their mechanical and chemical similarity to biological tissues, are widely used in biotechnologies, whereas semiconductors provide advanced electronic and optoelectronic functionalities such as signal amplification, sensing, and photomodulation. Combining semiconducting properties with hydrogel designs can enhance biointeractive functions and intimacy at biointerfaces, but this is challenging owing to the low hydrophilicity of polymer semiconductors. We developed a solvent affinity-induced assembly method that incorporates water-insoluble polymer semiconductors into double-network hydrogels. These semiconductors exhibited tissue-level moduli as soft as 81 kilopascals, stretchability of 150% strain, and charge-carrier mobility up to 1.4 square centimeters per volt per second. When they are interfaced with biological tissues, their tissue-level modulus enables alleviated immune reactions. The hydrogel's high porosity enhances molecular interactions at semiconductor-biofluid interfaces, resulting in photomodulation with higher response and volumetric biosensing with higher sensitivity.

title: Machine-guided design of cell-type-targeting cis-regulatory elements
summary_zh: 研究提出利用深度学习设计具有细胞类型特异性的顺式调控元件。通过模拟和实验验证，实现高效基因表达调控。
summary_en: Study proposes using deep learning to design cell-type-specific cis-regulatory elements. Simulation and experimental validation achieve efficient gene expression regulation.
insights: 创新点：深度学习在基因调控中的应用
方法亮点：细胞类型特异性顺式调控元件设计
关键发现：模拟和实验验证高效基因表达调控
insights_en: Novelty: Application of deep learning in gene regulation
Method highlight: Design of cell-type-specific cis-regulatory elements
Key finding: Simulation and experimental validation of efficient gene expression regulation
abstract: Cis-regulatory elements (CREs) control gene expression, orchestrating tissue identity, developmental timing and stimulus responses, which collectively define the thousands of unique cell types in the body<sup>1-3</sup>. While there is great potential for strategically incorporating CREs in therapeutic or biotechnology applications that require tissue specificity, there is no guarantee that an optimal CRE for these intended purposes has arisen naturally. Here we present a platform to engineer and validate synthetic CREs capable of driving gene expression with programmed cell-type specificity. We take advantage of innovations in deep neural network modelling of CRE activity across three cell types, efficient in silico optimization and massively parallel reporter assays to design and empirically test thousands of CREs<sup>4-8</sup>. Through large-scale in vitro validation, we show that synthetic sequences are more effective at driving cell-type-specific expression in three cell lines compared with natural sequences from the human genome and achieve specificity in analogous tissues when tested in vivo. Synthetic sequences exhibit distinct motif vocabulary associated with activity in the on-target cell type and a simultaneous reduction in the activity of off-target cells. Together, we provide a generalizable framework to prospectively engineer CREs from massively parallel reporter assay models and demonstrate the required literacy to write fit-for-purpose regulatory code.

title: Dissecting the hydrogen bond network of water: Charge transfer and nuclear quantum effects
summary_zh: 研究通过相关振动光谱揭示水分子间氢键网络的变化。发现OH-和H3O+在氢键网络中的电荷转移。
summary_en: Study reveals the changes in the hydrogen bond network of water using correlated vibrational spectroscopy. Finds charge transfer in the hydrogen bond network of water involving OH- and H3O+.
insights: 创新点：水分子间氢键网络研究新方法
方法亮点：相关振动光谱的应用
关键发现：OH-和H3O+在氢键网络中的电荷转移
insights_en: Novelty: New method for studying the hydrogen bond network of water molecules
Method highlight: Application of correlated vibrational spectroscopy
Key finding: Charge transfer in the hydrogen bond network involving OH- and H3O+
abstract: The molecular structure of water is dynamic, with intermolecular hydrogen (H) bond interactions being modified by both electronic charge transfer and nuclear quantum effects (NQEs). Electronic charge transfer and NQEs potentially change under acidic or basic conditions, but such details have not been measured. In this work, we developed correlated vibrational spectroscopy, a symmetry-based method that separates interacting from noninteracting molecules in self- and cross-correlation spectra, giving access to previously inaccessible information. We found that hydroxide (OH<sup>-</sup>) donated ~8% more negative charge to the H bond network of water, and hydronium (H<sub>3</sub>O<sup>+</sup>) accepted ~4% less negative charge from the H bond network of water. Deuterium oxide (D<sub>2</sub>O) had ~9% more H bonds compared with water (H<sub>2</sub>O), and acidic solutions displayed more dominant NQEs than basic ones.

title: Using artificial intelligence to document the hidden RNA virosphere
summary_zh: 研究利用深度学习算法发现高度分化的RNA病毒。识别出大量未研究的RNA病毒种类和超组。
summary_en: Study uses a deep learning algorithm to discover highly divergent RNA viruses. Identifies a large number of previously poorly studied RNA virus species and supergroups.
insights: 创新点：深度学习在RNA病毒发现中的应用
方法亮点：识别高度分化的RNA病毒
关键发现：大量未研究RNA病毒的识别
insights_en: Novelty: Application of deep learning in the discovery of RNA viruses
Method highlight: Identification of highly divergent RNA viruses
Key finding: Identification of a large number of previously poorly studied RNA viruses
abstract: Current metagenomic tools can fail to identify highly divergent RNA viruses. We developed a deep learning algorithm, termed LucaProt, to discover highly divergent RNA-dependent RNA polymerase (RdRP) sequences in 10,487 metatranscriptomes generated from diverse global ecosystems. LucaProt integrates both sequence and predicted structural information, enabling the accurate detection of RdRP sequences. Using this approach, we identified 161,979 potential RNA virus species and 180 RNA virus supergroups, including many previously poorly studied groups, as well as RNA virus genomes of exceptional length (up to 47,250 nucleotides) and genomic complexity. A subset of these novel RNA viruses was confirmed by RT-PCR and RNA/DNA sequencing. Newly discovered RNA viruses were present in diverse environments, including air, hot springs, and hydrothermal vents, with virus diversity and abundance varying substantially among ecosystems. This study advances virus discovery, highlights the scale of the virosphere, and provides computational tools to better document the global RNA virome.

title: Intermetallics triggering pyroptosis and disulfidptosis in cancer cells promote anti-tumor immunity
summary_zh: 开发触发癌细胞焦亡和二硫键裂解的金属间化合物。促进肿瘤微环境重塑和肿瘤细胞免疫原性。提高肿瘤免疫治疗的有效性。
summary_en: Develops intermetallics that trigger pyroptosis and disulfidptosis in cancer cells. Promotes remodeling of the tumor microenvironment and immunogenicity of tumor cells. Enhances the efficacy of cancer immunotherapy.
insights: 创新点：金属间化合物诱导癌细胞焦亡和二硫键裂解
方法亮点：结合生物催化和密度泛函理论计算
关键发现：提高肿瘤细胞对免疫治疗的敏感性
insights_en: Novelty: Intermetallics induce pyroptosis and disulfidptosis in cancer cells
Method highlight: Combined with biocatalysis and density functional theory calculations
Key finding: Enhances sensitivity of tumor cells to immunotherapy
abstract: Pyroptosis, an immunogenic programmed cell death, could efficiently activate tumor immunogenicity and reprogram immunosuppressive microenvironment for boosting cancer immunotherapy. However, the overexpression of SLC7A11 promotes glutathione biosynthesis for maintaining redox balance and countering pyroptosis. Herein, we develop intermetallics modified with glucose oxidase (GOx) and soybean phospholipid (SP) as pyroptosis promoters (Pd<sub>2</sub>Sn@GOx-SP), that not only induce pyroptosis by cascade biocatalysis for remodeling tumor microenvironment and facilitating tumor cell immunogenicity, but also trigger disulfidptosis mediated by cystine accumulation to further promote tumor pyroptosis in female mice. Experiments and density functional theory calculations show that Pd<sub>2</sub>Sn nanorods with an intermediate size exhibit stronger photothermal and enzyme catalytic activity compared with the other three morphologies investigated. The peroxidase-mimic and oxidase-mimic activities of Pd<sub>2</sub>Sn cause potent reactive oxygen species (ROS) storms for triggering pyroptosis, which could be self-reinforced by photothermal effect, hydrogen peroxide supply accompanied by glycometabolism, and oxygen production from catalase-mimic activity of Pd<sub>2</sub>Sn. Moreover, the increase of NADP<sup>+</sup>/NADPH ratio induced by glucose starvation could pose excessive cystine accumulation and inhibit glutathione synthesis, which could cause disulfidptosis and further augment ROS-mediated pyroptosis, respectively. This two-pronged treatment strategy could represent an alternative therapeutic approach to expand anti-tumor immunotherapy.

title: Early Intervention in Patients With Asymptomatic Severe Aortic Stenosis and Myocardial Fibrosis
summary_zh: 研究无症状严重主动脉瓣狭窄和心肌纤维化患者的早期干预。探讨早期干预对疾病进展的影响。
summary_en: This study investigates early intervention in patients with asymptomatic severe aortic stenosis and myocardial fibrosis. Explores the impact of early intervention on disease progression.
insights: 创新点：早期干预对无症状严重主动脉瓣狭窄的影响
方法亮点：临床试验设计
关键发现：早期干预可能延缓疾病进展
insights_en: Novelty: Impact of early intervention on asymptomatic severe aortic stenosis
Method highlight: Clinical trial design
Key finding: Early intervention may delay disease progression
abstract: ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT03094143.

title: Dialysis for Chronic Kidney Failure
summary_zh: 研究慢性肾衰竭透析治疗。分析透析时机和方式影响。评估生存率和死亡率。
summary_en: This study investigates chronic kidney failure dialysis treatments. Analyzes the impact of timing and modality on survival and mortality rates.
insights: 透析时机和方式影响生存率
死亡率相似于血液透析和腹膜透析
需考虑患者偏好和成本
insights_en: Dialysis timing and modality affect survival rates
Mortality rates are similar to hemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis
Patient preferences and costs should be considered
abstract: In 2021, more than 540 000 patients in the US received maintenance hemodialysis or peritoneal dialysis for treatment of chronic kidney failure. Five-year survival rate after initiation of maintenance dialysis is approximately 40%, and the mortality rate is similar with hemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis. Decisions about dialysis initiation timing and modality are influenced by patient symptoms, laboratory trajectories, patient preferences, and therapy cost and availability and should include shared decision-making.

title: Noninvasive, microbiome-based diagnosis of inflammatory bowel disease
summary_zh: 本文研究基于微生物组的炎症性肠病（IBD）诊断方法。通过分析来自不同地区和族裔的5,979个粪便样本，识别出IBD的微生物组变化，并构建了溃疡性结肠炎和克罗恩病的诊断模型。模型在发现队列中区分IBD与对照的AUC大于0.90。
summary_en: This paper investigates a microbiome-based diagnostic method for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). By analyzing fecal samples from diverse geographies and ethnicities, the study identifies microbiome alterations in IBD and constructs diagnostic models for ulcerative colitis and Crohn's disease. These models achieve AUCs over 0.90 in distinguishing IBD from controls in the discovery cohort.
insights: 创新点：首次利用微生物组数据构建IBD诊断模型
方法亮点：跨种族验证队列中模型表现良好
关键发现：模型在区分IBD与对照方面具有高准确性
insights_en: Novelty: First to construct IBD diagnostic models using microbiome data
Method highlight: Satisfactory performance in transethnic validation cohorts
Key finding: High accuracy in distinguishing IBD from controls
abstract: Despite recent progress in our understanding of the association between the gut microbiome and inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), the role of microbiome biomarkers in IBD diagnosis remains underexplored. Here we developed a microbiome-based diagnostic test for IBD. By utilization of metagenomic data from 5,979 fecal samples with and without IBD from different geographies and ethnicities, we identified microbiota alterations in IBD and selected ten and nine bacterial species for construction of diagnostic models for ulcerative colitis and Crohn's disease, respectively. These diagnostic models achieved areas under the curve >0.90 for distinguishing IBD from controls in the discovery cohort, and maintained satisfactory performance in transethnic validation cohorts from eight populations. We further developed a multiplex droplet digital polymerase chain reaction test targeting selected IBD-associated bacterial species, and models based on this test showed numerically higher performance than fecal calprotectin in discriminating ulcerative colitis and Crohn's disease from controls. Here we discovered universal IBD-associated bacteria and show the potential applicability of a multibacteria biomarker panel as a noninvasive tool for IBD diagnosis.

title: Noninvasive, microbiome-based diagnosis of inflammatory bowel disease
summary_zh: 尽管对肠道微生物组与炎症性肠病（IBD）之间的关联有了新的认识，但微生物组生物标志物在IBD诊断中的作用仍被低估。本研究开发了基于微生物组的IBD诊断测试。
summary_en: Despite recent insights into the association between the gut microbiome and inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), the role of microbiome biomarkers in IBD diagnosis remains underexplored. This study develops a microbiome-based diagnostic test for IBD.
insights: 创新点：开发基于微生物组的IBD诊断测试
方法亮点：利用跨地区和族裔的粪便样本数据
关键发现：识别出IBD的微生物组变化
insights_en: Novelty: Development of a microbiome-based diagnostic test for IBD
Method highlight: Utilization of fecal sample data from diverse geographies and ethnicities
Key finding: Identification of microbiome alterations in IBD
abstract: Despite recent progress in our understanding of the association between the gut microbiome and inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), the role of microbiome biomarkers in IBD diagnosis remains underexplored. Here we developed a microbiome-based diagnostic test for IBD. By utilization of metagenomic data from 5,979 fecal samples with and without IBD from different geographies and ethnicities, we identified microbiota alterations in IBD and selected ten and nine bacterial species for construction of diagnostic models for ulcerative colitis and Crohn's disease, respectively. These diagnostic models achieved areas under the curve >0.90 for distinguishing IBD from controls in the discovery cohort, and maintained satisfactory performance in transethnic validation cohorts from eight populations. We further developed a multiplex droplet digital polymerase chain reaction test targeting selected IBD-associated bacterial species, and models based on this test showed numerically higher performance than fecal calprotectin in discriminating ulcerative colitis and Crohn's disease from controls. Here we discovered universal IBD-associated bacteria and show the potential applicability of a multibacteria biomarker panel as a noninvasive tool for IBD diagnosis.

title: Home-based transcranial direct current stimulation treatment for major depressive disorder: a fully remote phase 2 randomized sham-controlled trial
summary_zh: 本研究是一项针对重度抑郁症（MDD）的10周家庭式经颅直流电刺激（tDCS）的随机安慰剂对照试验。参与者被随机分配到活性或安慰剂治疗。
summary_en: This study is a fully remote, multisite, double-blind, placebo-controlled, randomized superiority trial of 10-week home-based transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) for major depressive disorder (MDD). Participants were randomized to active or sham treatment.
insights: 创新点：家庭式tDCS治疗MDD
方法亮点：远程双盲随机对照试验
关键发现：活性治疗与安慰剂治疗对比
insights_en: Novelty: Home-based tDCS treatment for MDD
Method highlight: Remote double-blind randomized controlled trial
Key finding: Comparison between active and sham treatment
abstract: Transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) has been proposed as a new treatment in major depressive disorder (MDD). This is a fully remote, multisite, double-blind, placebo-controlled, randomized superiority trial of 10-week home-based tDCS in MDD. Participants were 18 years or older, with MDD in current depressive episode of at least moderate severity as measured using the Hamilton Depression Rating Scale (mean = 19.07 ± 2.73). A total of 174 participants (120 women, 54 men) were randomized to active (n = 87, mean age = 37.09 ± 11.14 years) or sham (n = 87, mean age = 38.32 ± 10.92 years) treatment. tDCS consisted of five sessions per week for 3 weeks then three sessions per week for 7 weeks in a 10-week trial, followed by a 10-week open-label phase. Each session lasted 30 min; the anode was placed over the left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex and the cathode over the right dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (active tDCS 2 mA and sham tDCS 0 mA, with brief ramp up and down to mimic active stimulation). As the primary outcome, depressive symptoms showed significant improvement when measured using the Hamilton Depression Rating Scale: active 9.41 ± 6.25 point improvement (10-week mean = 9.58 ± 6.02) and sham 7.14 ± 6.10 point improvement (10-week mean = 11.66 ± 5.96) (95% confidence interval = 0.51-4.01, P = 0.012). There were no differences in discontinuation rates. In summary, a 10-week home-based tDCS treatment with remote supervision in MDD showed high efficacy, acceptability and safety. ClinicalTrials.gov registration: NCT05202119.

title: MapTRv2: An End-to-End Framework for Online Vectorized HD Map Construction
MDM2 induces pro-inflammatory and glycolytic responses in M1 macrophages by integrating iNOS-nitric oxide and HIF-1α pathways in mice
summary_zh: MDM2通过整合iNOS-一氧化氮和HIF-1α通路促进M1巨噬细胞炎症和糖酵解。MDM2敲除可减轻肥胖引起的脂肪组织巨噬细胞炎症。
summary_en: MDM2 promotes inflammatory and glycolytic responses in M1 macrophages by integrating the iNOS-nitric oxide and HIF-1α pathways in mice. MDM2 haplodeletion can alleviate obesity-induced adipose tissue-resident macrophage inflammation.
insights: 创新点：揭示MDM2在M1巨噬细胞炎症和糖酵解中的作用。
方法亮点：通过小鼠模型研究MDM2的生物学功能。
关键发现：MDM2敲除可减轻肥胖引起的炎症。
insights_en: Novelty: Reveals the role of MDM2 in the inflammatory and glycolytic responses of M1 macrophages.
Method highlight: Studying the biological function of MDM2 using a mouse model.
Key finding: MDM2 haplodeletion can alleviate obesity-induced inflammation.
abstract: M1 macrophages induce protective immunity against infection, but also contribute to metabolic and inflammatory diseases. Here we show that the E3 ubiquitin ligase, MDM2, promotes the glycolytic and inflammatory activities of M1 macrophage by increasing the production of IL-1β, MCP-1 and nitric oxide (NO). Mechanistically, MDM2 triggers the ubiquitination and degradation of E3 ligase, SPSB2, to stabilize iNOS and increases production of NO, which s-nitrosylates and activates HIF-1α for triggering the glycolytic and pro-inflammatory programs in M1 macrophages. Myeloid-specific haplodeletion of MDM2 in mice not only blunts LPS-induced endotoxemia and NO production, but also alleviates obesity-induced adipose tissue-resident macrophage inflammation. By contrast, MDM2 haplodeletion induces higher mortality, tissue damage and bacterial burden, and also suppresses M1 macrophage response, in the cecal ligation and puncture-induced sepsis mouse model. Our findings thus identify MDM2 as an activator of glycolytic and inflammatory responses in M1 macrophages by connecting the iNOS-NO and HIF-1α pathways.

title: Home-based transcranial direct current stimulation treatment for major depressive disorder: a fully remote phase 2 randomized sham-controlled trial
summary_zh: 研究评估10周家庭式经颅直流电刺激（tDCS）治疗重度抑郁症的有效性。结果显示，tDCS对抑郁症患者有显著改善作用。
summary_en: This study evaluates the effectiveness of 10-week home-based transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) treatment for major depressive disorder. The results show that tDCS significantly improves symptoms in patients with depression.
insights: 创新点：首次进行远程家庭式tDCS治疗抑郁症的临床试验。
方法亮点：采用双盲随机安慰剂对照设计，提高研究结果的可靠性。
关键发现：tDCS对抑郁症患者有显著疗效。
insights_en: Novelty: The first clinical trial of remote home-based tDCS treatment for depression.
Method highlight: Utilizing a double-blind, randomized, sham-controlled design to enhance the reliability of the study results.
Key finding: tDCS shows significant efficacy in treating depression.
abstract: Transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) has been proposed as a new treatment in major depressive disorder (MDD). This is a fully remote, multisite, double-blind, placebo-controlled, randomized superiority trial of 10-week home-based tDCS in MDD. Participants were 18 years or older, with MDD in current depressive episode of at least moderate severity as measured using the Hamilton Depression Rating Scale (mean = 19.07 ± 2.73). A total of 174 participants (120 women, 54 men) were randomized to active (n = 87, mean age = 37.09 ± 11.14 years) or sham (n = 87, mean age = 38.32 ± 10.92 years) treatment. tDCS consisted of five sessions per week for 3 weeks then three sessions per week for 7 weeks in a 10-week trial, followed by a 10-week open-label phase. Each session lasted 30 min; the anode was placed over the left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex and the cathode over the right dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (active tDCS 2 mA and sham tDCS 0 mA, with brief ramp up and down to mimic active stimulation). As the primary outcome, depressive symptoms showed significant improvement when measured using the Hamilton Depression Rating Scale: active 9.41 ± 6.25 point improvement (10-week mean = 9.58 ± 6.02) and sham 7.14 ± 6.10 point improvement (10-week mean = 11.66 ± 5.96) (95% confidence interval = 0.51-4.01, P = 0.012). There were no differences in discontinuation rates. In summary, a 10-week home-based tDCS treatment with remote supervision in MDD showed high efficacy, acceptability and safety. ClinicalTrials.gov registration: NCT05202119.

title: Exploring structural diversity across the protein universe with The Encyclopedia of Domains
summary_zh: 研究使用深度学习方法检测和分类AlphaFold蛋白质结构数据库中的所有结构域。发现近365百万个结构域，比序列方法多出1亿多个。
summary_en: This study uses deep learning methods to detect and classify every domain in the AlphaFold Protein Structure Database. It finds nearly 365 million domains, over 100 million more than can be found by sequence methods.
insights: 创新点：深度学习方法在蛋白质结构域检测中的应用。
方法亮点：扩大了蛋白质结构域空间的代表性。
关键发现：发现大量新的结构域。
insights_en: Novelty: Application of deep learning methods in protein domain detection.
Method highlight: Greatly expands the representation of the protein domain space.
Key finding: Discovery of a large number of new domains.
abstract: The AlphaFold Protein Structure Database (AFDB) contains more than 214 million predicted protein structures composed of domains, which are independently folding units found in multiple structural and functional contexts. Identifying domains can enable many functional and evolutionary analyses but has remained challenging because of the sheer scale of the data. Using deep learning methods, we have detected and classified every domain in the AFDB, producing The Encyclopedia of Domains. We detected nearly 365 million domains, over 100 million more than can be found by sequence methods, covering more than 1 million taxa. Reassuringly, 77% of the nonredundant domains are similar to known superfamilies, greatly expanding representation of their domain space. We uncovered more than 10,000 new structural interactions between superfamilies and thousands of new folds across the fold space continuum.

title: MMed-RAG: Versatile Multimodal RAG System for Medical Vision Language Models
summary_zh: 研究提出MMed-RAG系统，用于解决医学视觉语言模型中的事实幻觉问题。系统结合了微调和检索增强生成方法，提高诊断准确性。
summary_en: This study proposes the MMed-RAG system to address the issue of factual hallucination in medical vision language models. The system combines fine-tuning and retrieval-augmented generation methods to improve diagnostic accuracy.
insights: 创新点：提出MMed-RAG系统解决医学视觉语言模型中的事实幻觉问题。
方法亮点：结合微调和检索增强生成方法，提高模型性能。
关键发现：系统在医学诊断中具有潜在应用价值。
insights_en: Novelty: Proposes the MMed-RAG system to address factual hallucination in medical vision language models.
Method highlight: Combining fine-tuning and retrieval-augmented generation methods to improve model performance.
Key finding: The system has potential application value in medical diagnosis.
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has demonstrated significant potential in healthcare, particularly in disease diagnosis and treatment planning. Recent progress in Medical Large Vision-Language Models (Med-LVLMs) has opened up new possibilities for interactive diagnostic tools. However, these models often suffer from factual hallucination, which can lead to incorrect diagnoses. Fine-tuning and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) have emerged as methods to address these issues. However, the amount of high-quality data and distribution shifts between training data and deployment data limit the application of fine-tuning methods. Although RAG is lightweight and effective, existing RAG-based approaches are not sufficiently general to different medical domains and can potentially cause misalignment issues, both between modalities and between the model and the ground truth. In this paper, we propose a versatile multimodal RAG system, MMed-RAG, designed to enhance the factuality of Med-LVLMs. Our approach introduces a domain-aware retrieval mechanism, an adaptive retrieved contexts selection method, and a provable RAG-based preference fine-tuning strategy. These innovations make the RAG process sufficiently general and reliable, significantly improving alignment when introducing retrieved contexts. Experimental results across five medical datasets (involving radiology, ophthalmology, pathology) on medical VQA and report generation demonstrate that MMed-RAG can achieve an average improvement of 43.8% in the factual accuracy of Med-LVLMs. Our data and code are available in https://github.com/richard-peng-xia/MMed-RAG.

title: Pervasive sublethal effects of agrochemicals on insects at environmentally relevant concentrations
summary_zh: 研究评估了农药对昆虫的亚致死影响。方法上，使用1024种化学物质的化学库进行测试。结果显示，亚致死剂量影响昆虫行为和生存率，并改变发育和繁殖。
summary_en: This study assesses the sublethal effects of agrochemicals on insects. Methods involve testing a chemical library of 1024 molecules. Results show that sublethal doses affect insect behavior and survivability and alter development and reproduction.
insights: 创新点：发现亚致死剂量对昆虫行为和生存率的影响。
方法亮点：使用广泛的化学物质库进行测试。
关键发现：温度升高时，农药的负面影响加剧。
insights_en: Novelty: Identified effects of sublethal doses on insect behavior and survivability.
Method highlight: Utilizing a broad chemical library for testing.
Key finding: Negative effects of agrochemicals are amplified with increased temperature.
abstract: Insect biomass is declining globally, likely driven by climate change and pesticide use, yet systematic studies on the effects of various chemicals remain limited. In this work, we used a chemical library of 1024 molecules-covering insecticides, herbicides, fungicides, and plant growth inhibitors-to assess the impact of sublethal pesticide doses on insects. In Drosophila melanogaster, 57% of chemicals affected larval behavior, and a higher proportion compromised long-term survivability. Exposure to sublethal doses also induced widespread changes in the phosphoproteome and changes in development and reproduction. The negative effects of agrochemicals were amplified when the temperature was increased. We observed similar behavioral changes across multiple insect species, including mosquitoes and butterflies. These findings suggest that widespread sublethal pesticide exposure can alter insect behavior and physiology, threatening long-term population survival.

title: Predictions of groundwater PFAS occurrence at drinking water supply depths in the United States
summary_zh: 研究建立模型预测美国地下水PFAS发生，发现大量人群依赖含PFAS的地下水。
summary_en: This study establishes a model to predict the occurrence of PFAS in groundwater at drinking water supply depths in the United States, finding that a large number of people rely on groundwater with detectable concentrations of PFAS for their drinking water supplies.
insights: 建立模型预测美国地下水PFAS发生
大量人群依赖含PFAS的地下水
地下水PFAS污染问题
insights_en: Establishes a model to predict PFAS occurrence in groundwater in the United States
A large number of people rely on groundwater with detectable PFAS
Groundwater PFAS contamination issue
abstract: Per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), known colloquially as "forever chemicals," have been associated with adverse human health effects and have contaminated drinking water supplies across the United States owing to their long-term and widespread use. People in the United States may unknowingly be drinking water that contains PFAS because of a lack of systematic analysis, particularly in domestic water supplies. We present an extreme gradient-boosting model for predicting the occurrence of PFAS in groundwater at the depths of drinking water supply for the conterminous United States. Our model results indicate that 71 million to 95 million people in the conterminous United States potentially rely on groundwater with detectable concentrations of PFAS for their drinking water supplies before any treatment.

title: Detection of interstellar 1-cyanopyrene: A four-ring polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon
summary_zh: 发现星际1-氰基芘，一种四环多环芳烃。利用绿岸望远镜观测TMC-1云，测得1-氰基芘柱密度。星际PAH化学有利于芘的产生。
summary_en: Detected interstellar 1-cyanopyrene, a four-ring PAH. Observed TMC-1 cloud with Green Bank Telescope, measured column density of 1-cyanopyrene. Interstellar PAH chemistry favors the production of pyrene.
insights: 发现星际1-氰基芘，首次证实其存在。
利用绿岸望远镜进行观测，提高了检测精度。
星际PAH化学有利于芘的产生，为行星系统提供碳源。
insights_en: First detection of interstellar 1-cyanopyrene confirmed its existence.
Observation with the Green Bank Telescope improved detection accuracy.
Interstellar PAH chemistry favors pyrene production, providing carbon sources for planetary systems.
abstract: Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) are organic molecules containing adjacent aromatic rings. Infrared emission bands show that PAHs are abundant in space, but only a few specific PAHs have been detected in the interstellar medium. We detected 1-cyanopyrene, a cyano-substituted derivative of the related four-ring PAH pyrene, in radio observations of the dense cloud TMC-1, using the Green Bank Telescope. The measured column density of 1-cyanopyrene is [Formula: see text] cm<sup>-2</sup>, from which we estimate that pyrene contains up to 0.1% of the carbon in TMC-1. This abundance indicates that interstellar PAH chemistry favors the production of pyrene. We suggest that some of the carbon supplied to young planetary systems is carried by PAHs that originate in cold molecular clouds.

title: Clade I mpox virus genomic diversity in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 2018–2024: Predominance of zoonotic transmission
Megastudy testing 25 treatments to reduce antidemocratic attitudes and partisan animosity
summary_zh: 大规模研究测试了25种减少美国民众反民主态度和党派敌意的治疗方法。
summary_en: A megastudy tested 25 treatments designed to reduce Americans' antidemocratic attitudes and partisan animosity.
insights: 创新点：大规模研究验证治疗方法
方法亮点：多种治疗方法比较
关键发现：多种方法有效减少反民主态度
insights_en: Novelty: Large-scale study validates treatment methods
Method highlight: Comparison of multiple treatment methods
Key finding: Multiple methods effectively reduce antidemocratic attitudes
abstract: Scholars warn that partisan divisions in the mass public threaten the health of American democracy. We conducted a megastudy (n = 32,059 participants) testing 25 treatments designed by academics and practitioners to reduce Americans' partisan animosity and antidemocratic attitudes. We find that many treatments reduced partisan animosity, most strongly by highlighting relatable sympathetic individuals with different political beliefs or by emphasizing common identities shared by rival partisans. We also identify several treatments that reduced support for undemocratic practices-most strongly by correcting misperceptions of rival partisans' views or highlighting the threat of democratic collapse-which shows that antidemocratic attitudes are not intractable. Taken together, the study's findings identify promising general strategies for reducing partisan division and improving democratic attitudes, shedding theoretical light on challenges facing American democracy.

title: Global health 2050: the path to halving premature death by mid-century

Protein language models learn evolutionary statistics of interacting sequence motifs
summary_zh: 研究探讨蛋白质语言模型（pLMs）在预测蛋白质结构和功能中的作用。方法通过“分类雅可比矩阵”计算，发现pLMs存储了共进化残基的统计信息。
summary_en: This study explores the role of protein language models (pLMs) in predicting protein structure and function. The method uses a 'categorical Jacobian' calculation to find that pLMs store statistics of coevolving residues.
insights: 创新点：发现pLMs存储了共进化残基的统计信息。
方法亮点：采用分类雅可比矩阵计算。
关键发现：pLMs能够学习蛋白质序列的进化统计信息。
insights_en: Novelty: Found that pLMs store statistics of coevolving residues.
Method highlight: Employed categorical Jacobian calculation.
Key finding: pLMs can learn evolutionary statistics of interacting sequence motifs.
abstract: Protein language models (pLMs) have emerged as potent tools for predicting and designing protein structure and function, and the degree to which these models fundamentally understand the inherent biophysics of protein structure stands as an open question. Motivated by a finding that pLM-based structure predictors erroneously predict nonphysical structures for protein isoforms, we investigated the nature of sequence context needed for contact predictions in the pLM Evolutionary Scale Modeling (ESM-2). We demonstrate by use of a "categorical Jacobian" calculation that ESM-2 stores statistics of coevolving residues, analogously to simpler modeling approaches like Markov Random Fields and Multivariate Gaussian models. We further investigated how ESM-2 "stores" information needed to predict contacts by comparing sequence masking strategies, and found that providing local windows of sequence information allowed ESM-2 to best recover predicted contacts. This suggests that pLMs predict contacts by storing motifs of pairwise contacts. Our investigation highlights the limitations of current pLMs and underscores the importance of understanding the underlying mechanisms of these models.

title: Cation reactivity inhibits perovskite degradation in efficient and stable solar modules
summary_zh: 研究通过在钙钛矿前驱体溶液中加入N,N-二甲基亚甲基脒氯化物，提高钙钛矿太阳能电池的稳定性。实验表明，这种方法有效抑制了钙钛矿的降解。
summary_en: This study improves the stability of perovskite solar modules by incorporating N,N-dimethylmethyleneiminium chloride into the perovskite precursor solution, demonstrating effective inhibition of perovskite degradation.
insights: 创新点：阳离子反应抑制钙钛矿降解
方法亮点：提高钙钛矿太阳能电池稳定性
关键发现：有效抑制钙钛矿降解
insights_en: Novelty: Cation reactivity inhibits perovskite degradation
Method highlight: Improved stability of perovskite solar modules
Key finding: Effective inhibition of perovskite degradation
abstract: Perovskite solar modules (PSMs) show outstanding power conversion efficiencies (PCEs), but long-term operational stability remains problematic. We show that incorporating N,N-dimethylmethyleneiminium chloride into the perovskite precursor solution formed dimethylammonium cation and that previously unobserved methyl tetrahydrotriazinium ([MTTZ]+) cation effectively improved perovskite film. The in situ formation of [MTTZ]+ cation increased the formation energy of iodine vacancies and enhanced the migration energy barrier of iodide and cesium ions, which suppressed nonradiative recombination, thermal decomposition, and phase segregation processes. The optimized PSMs achieved a record (certified) PCE of 23.2% with an aperture area of 27.2 cm2, with a stabilized PCE of 23.0%. The encapsulated PSM retained 87.0% of its initial PCE after ~1900 hours of maximum power point tracking at 85°C and 85% relative humidity under 1.0-sun illumination.

title: Expanded Newborn Screening Using Genome Sequencing for Early Actionable Conditions
summary_zh: 研究利用基因组测序进行新生儿筛查，以早期发现可干预的健康状况。该研究旨在通过基因组测序扩展新生儿筛查范围。
summary_en: This study utilizes genome sequencing for expanded newborn screening to identify early actionable health conditions, aiming to broaden the scope of newborn screening through genome sequencing.
insights: 创新点：基因组测序应用于新生儿筛查
方法亮点：早期发现可干预的健康状况
关键发现：扩展新生儿筛查范围
insights_en: Novelty: Application of genome sequencing in newborn screening
Method highlight: Early identification of actionable health conditions
Key finding: Expansion of newborn screening scope
abstract: ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT05990179.

title: Cadonilimab plus platinum-based chemotherapy with or without bevacizumab as first-line treatment for persistent, recurrent, or metastatic cervical cancer (COMPASSION-16): a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 3 trial in China
Identifying specific functional roles for senescence across cell types
summary_zh: 本研究通过构建p16<sup>Ink4a</sup>相关遗传系统，研究了细胞衰老在不同细胞类型中的功能角色。研究发现，巨噬细胞和内皮细胞在肝脏纤维化和修复过程中具有不同的命运和功能。
summary_en: This study investigates the specific functional roles of senescence across various cell types using p16<sup>Ink4a</sup>-related genetic systems. The study found that macrophages and endothelial cells have distinct fates and functions during liver fibrosis and repair.
insights: 创新点：构建了p16<sup>Ink4a</sup>相关遗传系统
方法亮点：通过肝脏损伤和修复研究细胞衰老功能
关键发现：巨噬细胞和内皮细胞在肝脏纤维化和修复中具有不同功能
insights_en: Novelty: Construction of p16<sup>Ink4a</sup>-related genetic systems
Method highlight: Study of cellular senescence function through liver injury and repair
Key finding: Macrophages and endothelial cells have different functions during liver fibrosis and repair
abstract: Cellular senescence plays critical roles in aging, regeneration, and disease; yet, the ability to discern its contributions across various cell types to these biological processes remains limited. In this study, we generated an in vivo genetic toolbox consisting of three p16<sup>Ink4a</sup>-related intersectional genetic systems, enabling pulse-chase tracing (Sn-pTracer), Cre-based tracing and ablation (Sn-cTracer), and gene manipulation combined with tracing (Sn-gTracer) of defined p16<sup>Ink4a+</sup> cell types. Using liver injury and repair as an example, we found that macrophages and endothelial cells (ECs) represent distinct senescent cell populations with different fates and functions during liver fibrosis and repair. Notably, clearance of p16<sup>Ink4a+</sup> macrophages significantly mitigates hepatocellular damage, whereas eliminating p16<sup>Ink4a+</sup> ECs aggravates liver injury. Additionally, targeted reprogramming of p16<sup>Ink4a+</sup> ECs through Kdr overexpression markedly reduces liver fibrosis. This study illuminates the functional diversity of p16<sup>Ink4a+</sup> cells and offers insights for developing cell-type-specific senolytic therapies in the future.
